nom: TONYMOLY I'm Charcoal All Over Blemish Patch

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-T-zone skin report the patches absorb sebum and draw out gunk from congested pores, with some calling it especially suited to their skin type.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report the patches helped treat blemishes and fit well over larger areas like the chin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive or easily irritated report the patches were rough and painful to remove, leaving redness, with one exception describing zero irritation.
segments.mature: One reviewer notes the patch left temporary wrinkling/creasing on the skin overnight that resolved quickly.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers mention temporary wrinkling or fine lines from the patch sitting on skin overnight, which faded soon after removal.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer reports the patches dried out her skin with no other benefit, while another says they did not dry her out despite fearing they would.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness and calmer-looking skin, especially around blemishes, though a few describe new redness or red blotches from the patch itself or its removal.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers with easily irritated skin describe the removal as rough, ripping, or leaving skin bumpy and irritated, while most others report no irritation or damage.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report visible flattening of pimples, reduced pus, and faster healing of individual spots after one overnight use, but several say they saw no visible change in their blemishes at all.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including those with cystic or clustered acne, report the patches drew out oil and pus and reduced breakout size or redness, while a notable minority (including some who tried it specifically for acne) report no noticeable effect.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers frequently report the patches pulled visible oil, gunk, and blackhead material from the nose, forehead, and T-zone, with only one reviewer saying the patch stopped sticking because her face was too oily.

aspects.libelle: Visible gunk/oil pulled out on patch
Difficult to peel from backing/apply smoothly
Stays stuck overnight without falling off
One patch per area, expensive for single use

extraits.texte: I have easily irritated skin, and unfortunately this was very rough coming off in the morning. More of a ripping than a gentle peel that left my skin very red. I also didn't notice any affect on my blemishes like other pimple patch products have helped, sadly.

This product has helped my skin so much. I suffer from cystic acne and my skin is always in a lot of pain. This product helped to drain oil from my skin and help to reduce the red appearance. I recommend this product to my friends and family. Gifted by tonymoly

I bought these in store a couple of days ago, not expecting much, but i have super hard water, and my pores have been literally the worst tbey have EVER been im my 26 years of life. I washed my face like the instructions said, i toned, and then put the patch on for like 9-10 hours. I cooked and did stuff around the hiuse snd did get a bit sweaty. After i removed the patch, i washed my face with la rouche posay face wash with salicylic acid, and toned, and i cannot express how dramatically this changed my pores. I mean i was genuinely shook. My partner noticed the difference too and he was shook as well. I cannot recommend this enough.

I really wanted to like this but I really didn't. It was hard to apply smoothly onto my skin and it didn't even stick to the side of my nostrils (where I have the most pores) because of the plastic packaging. Maybe I applied it wrong and was supposed to off the plastic first? It's uncomfortable that I have to keep it on for 8 hours and sleep with it on and the morning after it left some prints on my face where the creases were. My face was slightly smoother but I don't think it really did anything for my pores. It's also pretty expensive because there's only one patch for each area. This was gifted by tonymoly but all thoughts are my own.

Love these! I wore it right after cleansing and drying my face and went to bed. The patches stick well and it's not uncomfortable to sleep in it - because that was my fear, but nope, totally fine. Removed it in the morning and no sticky residue and no irritation. Showered and my skin felt super clean and my zits are definitely less noticeable and not t red or irritated. Definitely a life saver if you have an event the next day or anything like that. Will always keep these handy! Thankful to have received this complimentary from TONYMOLY.

extraits.titre: Didn't do enough for my acne
extraits.texte: I am an avid user of pimple patches—I buy them weekly. I was excited to try this product and followed the instructions for application. The sheets were thin but forgiving. If I misplaced the sticker, I was able to reapply it to the correct place. After applying, I went to bed and allowed the stickers to sit on my skin overnight. When I woke up, I took the stickers off but did not notice much of a difference with my acne. The stickers themself were thin and could not absorb a lot of oil or imperfections. All in all, I wouldn't purchase this product because for the price and the one use application, it didn't do enough for my acne. Gifted by tonymoly

Complimentary from TONYMOLY I love the fact that these are made with charcoal, which is a Natural cleansing ingredient, and niacinamide that will help with the redness of blemishes. This product is really great for people with oily t zones.. It removed a lot of gross stuff I did not suspect is on those zones. I see results and it works great for my skin
